faq.a: Hyper Tek is an advanced Web3.5 play-to-earn gaming ecosystem featuring a dynamic marketplace, set in a distant future. It was developed to address major issues in current gaming and digital artworks, providing greater player ownership over the game experience. The ecosystem includes three interconnected games: Hyper Racing, Hyper Quest, and Overlord of the 7 Realms, all sharing a unified economy and progression system. Every action you take in these games contributes to real-world rewards.

To understand Web3.5, look at the systemic failures of modern gaming. Traditional Web2 gaming offers polished gameplay, but traps players in closed loops where time and money vanish the moment you log off. Early Web3 gaming promised a "Play-to-Earn" revolution but delivered a broken experience. In reality, "play-to-earn" turned out to be "own worthless, volatile tokens," plagued by hyperinflation, frustrating crypto wallet barriers, and aggressive pay-to-win mechanics that ruined competitive balance.
Web3.5 is our custom hybrid architecture engineered to bridge this gap. We provide the frictionless, instant entry of Web2: log in with a standard email and play, while running a highly sophisticated, multi-layered blockchain backbone to power a true, sustainable virtual economy.

The Core Pillars of the Hyper Tek Ecosystem

Interlinked Three-Game Ecosystem & VR Integration
To eliminate player boredom, Web3.5 unifies three entirely distinct game genres, Racing, Quest, and Overlord Realm, into a single ecosystem with unified player progression. Your achievements in one world directly propel your standing in the others, with full VR integration planned to bring real-time immersive gameplay to every mode.

Dynamic Asset Interoperability
Assets in Hyper Tek are not static images. Every vehicle, item, and modifier features shifting utility models. When an asset crosses from the racing garage into the Overlord battlefield, its data structures dynamically translate. Bonuses automatically shift to match the physics, mechanics, and tactical needs of that specific environment.

Algorithmic Competitive Balance (Anti-Pay-to-Win)
We have addressed the toxic pay-to-win loop that destroys gaming communities. The ecosystem applies diminishing returns on stacked item bonuses, so raw purchasing power alone can never dominate. While premium assets offer distinct strategic utility, the balancing ensures skill remains the deciding factor over spending.

Real Cash Economics & Digital Commerce
We replaced speculative, inflationary alt-tokens with a dual-engine economy built for real-world value.
Play-to-Earn Real Cash: supported by a Guaranteed Minimum Buy-Back Fund locked inside an untouchable smart contract on the Base network, ensuring transparent, public baseline values.
True Decentralised Commerce: the network is fully integrated with user profiles and the global marketplace, allowing players to establish legitimate digital businesses, trade seamlessly, and upload their own custom assets directly into the ecosystem.

faq.q: What are NFAs, NFCs, and NFTs?
faq.a:
NFAs/NFCs/NFTs are Hyper Tek’s digital artworks that all have a guaranteed minimum buy-back and offer in-game bonuses.

Non-Fungible Assets (NFAs) are the rarest tier in the Hyper Tek ecosystem. These NFAs are architect-created artworks with the biggest in-game bonuses of any artwork tier. They are released completely at random when players buy packages and awarded as exclusive rewards during major in-game events. These are rare, powerful, and highly sought after.

Non-Fungible Collectables (NFCs) also deliver in-game bonuses and can be created by both the game architects and by players who follow specific parameters. NFCs open the door for the community to contribute creativity while still earning real gameplay advantages. They are collectibles that combine player expression with competitive utility.

Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) are fully player-created artworks. While they do not carry direct in-game bonuses, they can be collected and used to decorate a player’s base or spaceship, and that customisation contributes to an overall power level bonus. This is where your creativity becomes your competitive edge and the beginning of your play-to-earn journey.

faq.q: How does the buy-back guarantee work?
faq.a:
Protect your investment with our robust buy-back guarantee! Each digital artwork is backed by a minimum buy-back value that not only increases with every resale but is also adjusted for inflation twice a year, ensuring that your investment retains its value.

Every time a digital artwork is sold, at least 5% of the commission is added to the buy-back value, allowing it to grow continuously. If you're selling your artwork on the Hyper Tek marketplace and do not receive an offer above the minimum buy-back amount, we've got you covered! The Hyper Tek marketplace will purchase the artwork from you and pay you the current minimum buy-back amount. This guarantees that your investment always remains protected!

faq.a:
Eager to earn real-world rewards? It's easy! Just follow these simple steps:

1. Sign up and link your wallet.
2. Dive into the action as soon as the games launch!

Maximise your earnings by completing quests from the Questing Board, tackling daily tasks, joining tournaments and events, crafting and selling digital art, or investing in and renting out digital artwork. The opportunities to earn tangible rewards and convert your in-game currency into actual cash are plentiful!

IF you're a savvy investor, grab some limited edition NFAs that offer unparalleled in-game bonuses that are currently up for grabs. Opportunities like these won't come around again! Keep some to elevate your gameplay and embark on your quest to become a legendary Overload. When the time is right, you can also sell them for profit or hire them out for a steady income. Investing now not only propels your gaming journey but also supports the project's future.

Three games are currently in development within the Hyper Tek universe and will launch as part of the ecosystem:

Hyper Racing: High-speed circuit racing on alien planets featuring hostile environments. Players will be able to fully upgrade their flying racing vehicles, with racing specialists and pit managers playing crucial roles in reaching the top of the leaderboard. By honing piloting skills, players can become a dominant force throughout the Hyper Tek universe.

Hyper Quest: An explorer's dream, offering puzzle-solving missions that take players deep into the known and unknown regions of the Hyper Tek universe. There will be plenty of galaxies to explore and missions to undertake in this kill-or-be-killed environment, where every turn could be your last. The rewards are designed to be substantial to offset the risks, and like the other two linked games, a lot of the rewards will pay in Hyper Bucks, which can be converted into real cash payments.

Overlord of the 7 Realms: A tri-level strategy game that focuses on dominion and conquest. Players will command their armies across open terrains while overseeing operations from a strategic orbital position in space. The gameplay will test players' wits as they launch attacks, defend territories, and counterattack across three planes: ground-ground, ground-space, and space-space.

All three games are being built as interconnected, sharing the same economy and player progression once they launch.

VR and AR support is part of Hyper Tek's design and will become part of the gaming experience as the platform develops. The goal is full cross-platform play, so VR headset, AR, mobile, and traditional players can eventually join the same missions and battles together, from any device.

Once available, we expect the VR/AR layer to open up entirely new ways to experience the Hyper Tek universe.

faq.q: What is a Hyper Tek "Phygital" Asset Certificate?
faq.a:
A Phygital Asset Certificate is the ultimate bridge between virtual victory and real-world asset collection, and will be available once the games are launched. Every time you buy or mint a premium item natively on the blockchain, you'll unlock the exclusive right to use our on-demand printing gate. You'll be able to order a high-quality, collectible Baseball-Style Printing Card for every single item bought on the chain. For virtual land territories, you'll also be able to officially order an authentic Physical Paper Land Title Deed shipped directly to your physical home address.

Are these physical certificates just novelty printouts? Absolutely not. Every single physical certificate functions as an off-chain physical anchor tightly synchronized with the on-chain Blockchain. Each card or deed is individually stamped with an official certified gold seal, your exact cryptographic Base blockchain Token ID, and the precise digital asset parameters or coordinate matrix mapped straight from the live game database. It stands as an official, legally verifiable physical record of our company ecosystem history.

faq.q: If an item is sold on the marketplace, what happens to the physical certificate?
faq.a: True ownership resides immutably on the Base blockchain, which acts as the ultimate source of truth. Because third-party buyers and sellers can be lazy, players do not need to physically mail cards or paper documents to each other when an asset changes hands. The moment an item transitions to a new owner on the Base network ledger, the previous physical certificate simply becomes a historical collector's item. The new owner listed on the Base blockchain instantly unlocks the programmatic right to log into their Hyper Tek profile and order their own freshly generated, custom physical certificate or deed directly from our fulfillment engine to match their live Base chain asset.

faq.q: Can I order more than one physical certificate for an item I own on the chain?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. You hold absolute sovereignty over your property on the Base blockchain. If your profile is verified as the current on-chain owner of the asset on Base Mainnet, our system allows you to order as many physical cards or deeds for that specific item as you want. There are no limits.

faq.q: Why would a player order multiple physical matching items?
faq.a: This creates a massive secondary real-world collector loop driven by community. Players can order multiple certified physical cards or trade, swap, or sell face-to-face with friends, guild members, or collectors at real-world e-sports tournaments and gaming meetups. While the gameplay power and GMBB liquidity floor remain locked to the primary asset on the Base blockchain, the physical gold-sealed items carry immense independent tangible value for collectors. It is entirely up to the players to freely trade, negotiate, or mail these physical assets between their own will.
